integrity: Analytic proofs given; standard-library numerical/exact spot checks are corroborative only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: High-power spectral asymptotics hold for fixed Bergman weight; no uniform weight limits or finite-power resolution of the exponentially small peak shift. Closely related preprint beyond introduction/theorem statements unavailable for full-text priority comparison.
title: Mesoscopic spectral law and infinitely flat peak detachment for powers of Bergman shifts
